items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And Doctor Murphy said it sounds like a stroke.

ctx.x: And Marge explained it to him.

And Doctor Murphy said it sounds like a stroke. And so he said, I'm going to call the Veteran's Hospital and you take him down. And he called me back, said I'll call you back. Said you have Zutty down there around one o'clock, don't rush.

And when we went down there they had a bed for Zutty and all. We had to sit in that Veteran's Hospital from about 2.30 until 8 o'clock at night. The Neurologist wasn't there. Until 8 o'clock at night and Zutty was getting worse and worse. And they had some crazy guys you know out of the army, young fellows who were there to be admitted. And one got in a wheel chair and was running all around the place. And the other one was talking crazy. We had to sit through all of that.
